$doc: What scripts/measure-covers.ts can't tell from a scan's pixels, keyed <folder>/<file> under scans/. Scans are used only for where branding sits and its colours; sizes come from each case's documented standard, and every scan is stretched to it. Fields: exclude (a reason: left out of the report), bleedMm (bleed round the trim on every side, cropped off before stretching), note. Add an entry only for something checked against the image.
